context: /close-epic round 2 — three forks opened by round 1's answers on PR-opening (q7) and resolving #174 (q8). Nothing here re-asks round 1.

questions.text: Opening the PR contradicts three stated lines — work-through.md:24 'never open PRs', :321 'the PR is theirs', and work-on.md:29 'Never open the PR yourself'. How should that be reconciled?
questions.hint: [intent] The PreToolUse hook (hooks/gate-reminder.sh) still fires on gh pr create and asks for confirmation regardless, so this is about stated product posture, not about safety. /finish already opens PRs, but it is a skill — the recommend-only invariant binds commands.
choices: Scope it — the read-only rule binds dispatched phases, and a human-invoked closeout is stated as outside it
Amend it — rewrite the three lines so /close-epic is the named PR-opening path at epic scale
Keep it — drop PR-opening from /close-epic after all
questions.recommended_choice: Scope it — the read-only rule binds dispatched phases, and a human-invoked closeout is stated as outside it

questions.text: What should /close-epic put in the body of the PR it opens?
questions.hint: [contract] The evidence table was cut from the kernel and delegated to /handback, so it is not automatically available here — only if the branch already has a handback manifest committed.
choices: Epic goal, per-story verdict trail, and links to the issues just filed
The same, plus the /handback evidence manifest when the branch already has one
/finish's PR body shape, adapted to epic scale
questions.recommended_choice: The same, plus the /handback evidence manifest when the branch already has one

questions.text: Which disambiguation should this design pin for the PASS token collision (#174)?
questions.hint: [contract] Renaming is cleanest but touches 14 files — status-flip (15 hits), build/SKILL.md (21), DESIGN.md (5), plus 8 test files. Scoping by table costs almost nothing but leans on reader context, which is what failed.
choices: Rename the build task status to VERIFIED, leaving PASS to mean a gate verdict only
Scope by table — each token valid only inside its own table, stated once in DESIGN.md
questions.recommended_choice: Rename the build task status to VERIFIED, leaving PASS to mean a gate verdict only
